policy.activation_rule: Trigger MAO only when the user explicitly asks to use mao mode/mao skill, or while mao mode is already active in the current conversation.
policy.non_activation_rule: Do not trigger from decision-analysis topic alone. Installing, editing, or discussing the skill is not activation.
